title: Avatar: The Last Airbender Promos: card flavor text

entities.name: Aang
entities.description: The Avatar, who returned when the world needed him most and unleashed the ocean's fury on the Fire Nation fleet.

entities.name: Avatar Yangchen
entities.description: A past Avatar who speaks of selfless duty to protect the world.

entities.name: Avatar Roku
entities.description: A past Avatar who urges decisiveness.

entities.name: Avatar Kyoshi
entities.description: A past Avatar who holds that only justice will bring peace.

entities.name: Suki
entities.description: A courageous rescuer who urges her allies to finish the mission.

entities.name: Hakoda
entities.description: A leader who lays out the plan for the Avatar to defeat the Fire Lord and end the war.

entities.name: The Mechanist
entities.description: An aerial artisan focused on improving what is already there.

entities.name: Yue
entities.description: The Moon Spirit, whose death drove the Avatar to vengeance.

entities.name: Mai
entities.description: A scornful striker who loves Zuko more than she fears her opponent.

entities.name: Zuko
entities.description: A prince whose journey began refusing to duel his father and ended dueling his sister; as Fire Lord he declares the war over.

entities.name: Iroh
entities.description: A wise firebender who teaches about the elements and learned to redirect lightning.

entities.name: Ozai
entities.description: The cruel Fire Lord, later the Phoenix King, who seeks a new world born from ashes.

entities.name: Azula
entities.description: Zuko's sister, who duels him in the last Agni Kai.

entities.name: Katara
entities.description: A fearless heroine who vows never to turn her back on people in need.

entities.name: Sokka
entities.description: A bold boomerang-wielder.

entities.name: The Earth King
entities.description: The ruler of the Earth Kingdom.

entities.name: Bosco
entities.description: A creature associated with the Earth King.

entities.name: La
entities.description: The ocean spirit joined with Aang in fury.

entities.name: General Sung
entities.description: A general who explains Ba Sing Se's name.

entities.name: Admiral Zhao
entities.description: A Fire Nation admiral who describes Agna Qel'a's icy landscape.

entities.name: Chong
entities.description: A nomad musician who sings of the secret tunnel.

entities.name: Koh
entities.description: A spirit whose home lies in spiraling depths.

entities.name: Wan Shi Tong
entities.description: The owner of a planetarium that charts heavenly bodies.

entities.name: Fire Nation
entities.description: The nation ruled by the Fire Lord, whose fleet and capital are targets of the Avatar's allies.

entities.name: Team Avatar
entities.description: The Avatar's group, which stormed the capital on the Day of Black Sun.

entities.name: Fire Nation capital
entities.description: The capital of the Fire Nation.

entities.name: Ba Sing Se
aliases: The Walls of Ba Sing Se
entities.description: The impenetrable walled city.

entities.name: Planetarium of Wan Shi Tong
entities.description: A planetarium charting heavenly bodies to forecast the fates of nations.

entities.name: Abandoned Air Temple
entities.description: An air temple once full of monks, lemurs, and bison.

entities.name: Agna Qel'a
entities.description: A treacherous frozen tundra, an icy fortress.

entities.name: Jasmine Dragon Tea Shop
entities.description: A tea shop where the secret ingredient is love.

entities.name: Realm of Koh
entities.description: The spiraling depths Koh calls home.

entities.name: Secret Tunnel
entities.description: A tunnel celebrated in song by Chong.

entities.name: White Lotus Tile
entities.description: A game tile Iroh considers essential to his unusual strategy.

entities.name: Day of Black Sun
entities.description: A solar eclipse that robbed Firebenders of their power for eight minutes.

entities.name: The Last Agni Kai
entities.description: The final duel between Zuko and his sister.

events.summary: In the past, Aang knew the air temple to be full of monks, lemurs, and bison (memory).
events.quote: Aang once knew this place to be full of monks, lemurs, and bison.

events.summary: The Avatar returns when the world needs him most, and every creature feels it.
events.quote: When the world needed him most, the Avatar returned.

events.summary: After the death of the moon spirit, the Avatar's tides of vengeance crash over the Fire Nation fleet.
events.quote: With the death of the moon spirit, the Avatar's tides of vengeance crashed over the Fire Nation fleet.

events.summary: Aang delves into the spiraling depths in search of Koh's home.
events.quote: Aang delved deep into the spiraling depths in search of wherever Koh called home.

events.summary: Hakoda lays out the plan to defeat the Fire Lord, take the capital, and end the war.
events.quote: When this is finished, the Avatar will have defeated the Fire Lord, we will have control of the Fire Nation capital, and this war will be over!

events.summary: On the Day of Black Sun, an eclipse strips Firebenders of power, giving Team Avatar eight minutes to storm the capital.
events.quote: The solar eclipse robbed Firebenders of their ability to firebend, giving Team Avatar an eight-minute window to storm the capital and defeat the Fire Lord.

events.summary: Zuko's journey, begun when he refused to duel his father, ends with him dueling his sister Azula in the last Agni Kai.
events.quote: Zuko's journey began when he refused to duel his father, but it would end dueling his sister.

events.summary: As Fire Lord, Zuko declares the war finally over.
events.quote: Today, this war is finally over!

relations.quote: I love Zuko more than I fear you.
I'm sorry it has to end this way, brother.

relations.note: They duel in the last Agni Kai.

relations.quote: the Avatar's tides of vengeance crashed over the Fire Nation fleet.
